summary: Woori Financial Group Inc. (WFG) filed a Form 6-K reporting a board resolution for a small-scale share exchange with TONGYANG Life Insurance Co., Ltd. Under the agreement, WFG will issue 0.2521056 new common shares per Tongyang share, making Tongyang a wholly-owned subsidiary. The exchange does not exceed 10% of WFG's issued shares, so board approval suffices under Korean law. Capital stock will increase by KRW 43,484,375,000. The board resolution date is expected July 24, 2026, and the share exchange August 11, 2026. Watch for dissenting shareholder appraisal rights and any regulatory approval under the Financial Holding Companies Act.
